'''Fuling totems''' are rare items found in the [[Plains]].

== Usage ==
{{main|Forsaken Altars}}
A total of five Fuling totems are required to summon [[Yagluth]], the fifth boss of [[Valheim (world)|Valheim]].

==Availability==
Fuling totems can be obtained from various sources:
* In [[Fuling Village]]s, with a 50% chance next to each [[Bonfire]].
* Guaranteed inside some variants of [[Fuling Outpost]]s.
* As a 10% drop from [[Fuling Berserker]]s.
* As a 2.8% drop from [[Loot chest#Stonehenge Center Chest|chest]] in [[Stonehenge]]s.

== Gallery ==
<gallery widths="185">
Fuling totempole.png
Vreddit01.png
File:Fuling fort idol mount.jpg|Fuling totems are often found on mounts like this at the back of small stone buildings that the Fulings have repaired as forts.
</gallery>

== Notes ==
* If the pedestal on which the totem rests is destroyed before the player interacts with the totem, the totem will not be dropped.
* The totem bears some resemblance to Yagluth, especially the crown. It is implied through various [[Runestone|Runestones]] that the [[Fuling|Fulings]] worship him as some sort of king or deity.
* Totems are fairly uncommon and are not guaranteed to be present in points of interest in the Plains.
